_readme: Source of truth for every authored skill: beast skills, the avatar's active skills and passives, the skill-training materials, and each species' learnable skills and default loadout. Drafted against a power budget and tuned with the roster against the balance simulator (default loadouts; see docs/balance/tuning-log.md), not confirmed balance. Edit here, then in Unity run Beast Craft/Data/Import Skill Library (after Import Beast Roster). Enums are member names (case-sensitive). Missing fields take the DTO defaults in SkillLibraryData.cs; note a missing TargetingCriterion means Distance (nearest), not Random. Damage Magnitude is power, a percent of the attacking stat; Heal is a percent of the caster's SpecialAttack (x HealScale, the avatar's for its skills and passives); a Shield is a percent of the caster's Defense; a DamageOverTime is a per-turn power; a Knockback is whole hexes. DefaultLoadout order is fire priority. TeamBonds are composition-triggered team behaviours for the player's team (never enemies): a Stance, Elements (distinct elements of the set the team covers), Species or DistinctStances condition, tiers by rising MinCount (the highest reached applies; tiers replace, not stack), each with battle-start Effects (BuffStat or a Shield status only, Chance 100, applied by each recipient to itself; Scope Members = the beasts that meet the condition, Team = every beast, Others = every beast that does not meet it) and/or an in-battle Reaction: when its Trigger happens (EnemyTargetsAlly, AllyCrit, AllyHitByEnemy, MemberHit, MemberCrit, AllyBelowHpPercent, AllyTurnStartAfflicted, AllyDefeated), the first member that is alive, unstunned, in Range, off its Cooldown (its own turns) and under its caps (MaxPerMember, MaxPerTriggerUnit, MaxPerBattle) passes a Chance roll and casts the reaction's Effects on its Target (Self, TriggeringAlly, TriggerTarget, Attacker, EnemiesNearReactor, Team), or with Action Intercept takes an enemy's single-target hit in an adjacent ally's place. Reactions never chain. A PerCount (scaling) bond has one tier (MinCount 1 or more) whose magnitudes apply once per counted member, up to MaxCount stacks, and no reaction. See docs/design/battle-system.md, 'Team bonds'. The first 3 AvatarActives are the avatar's default actives. See docs/design/battle-system.md, 'Beast skill kits'.

Materials.Description: A sliver of crystallised battle essence. Feeds a skill a little XP; opens its first breakthrough (level 5).
A clear crystal of battle essence. Feeds a skill a good deal of XP; opens its second breakthrough (level 10).
The dense heart of a great battle's essence. Feeds a skill a large amount of XP; opens its final breakthrough (level 15).

BeastSkills.Description: A ponderous stone fist. Hits hard enough to matter, never hard enough to carry a fight.
The Golem plants itself and bellows; enemies within three hexes find they cannot look away.
Raises slabs of granite around itself and every ally within two hexes: a shield worth part of the Golem's Defense.
A shoulder charge that sends the target skidding two hexes back.
Stamps the ground: everything within two hexes is shaken and may be slowed.
Hardens its hide: more Defense and Special Defense for three turns.
A crushing bite from the deep.
Churns the water into a whirlpool: enemies within three hexes are drawn to the Leviathan (taunted) and slowed.
Coils behind its scales and closes its wounds: a shield worth about two-thirds of its Defense and a small heal.
A wall of water down a three-hex line that may knock the front rank back.
A churning vortex around the Leviathan that wears down Special Defense.
A cool tide washes over allies within two hexes, healing them and hardening their guard.
A whip of thorned vine that leaves a festering wound (stacks three times).
Sap and leaf close the wounds of whichever ally within three hexes is worst off.
Grows a skin of bark over every ally within two hexes.
Roots burst from the ground and may hold the target fast for a turn.
Releases choking spores around itself: a lingering poison that also saps strength.
The whole team blossoms: a heal and a Defense boost.
A rending strike that cracks armour: -12% Defense for three turns, stacking up to three times.
The Tarasque brings its whole plated weight down on one foe.
Braces behind its plates and waits for the counterblow: more Defense and Attack for three turns.
Bristles its spines: a shield and a Special Defense boost.
Sheds a storm of metal scales at everything adjacent.
A two-hex charge that flattens the line and shoves the front of it back.
A shard of ice that chills: -8% Speed for three turns, stacking up to three times.
Encases the target in ice; it may be frozen solid for a turn.
A freezing exhalation over everything within two hexes; may chill (stacks three times).
Driving snow along all six axes, three hexes out.
Coats itself in rime: a shield and more Special Defense.
Once a battle, the air itself freezes: every enemy is struck and may be frozen.
Three quick bolts loosed from its talons at two hexes at the enemy with the least HP left in reach: many weak hits, each its own crit roll.
Lightning arcs between everything within two hexes, three times over: its answer to a swarm.
Builds a charge in its feathers: +25 crit chance and more Speed for three turns.
Opens the fight with a single dive from the clouds: one heavy hit, once per battle.
A deafening crack around itself that may stun.
Four bolts down a four-hex line.
A diving rake of talons.
A spear of compressed air down a three-hex line.
A beat of great wings that hurls everything adjacent two hexes away.
Rides the wind: harder to pin down (more Defense and Special Defense; there is no evasion stat) and one more hex of movement for two turns.
Lifts the whole team on a rising wind: more Speed and one more hex of movement.
A plummeting strike that tears through armour.
A bolt of flame that sets the target burning (stacks three times).
A sheet of fire down a four-hex line; may leave it burning.
Once a battle, the Phoenix wreathes itself in renewing fire: a heal and a large shield. There is no revive mechanic; this is the honest stand-in.
A concentrated lance of fire at up to four hexes.
Fire rains on every enemy and leaves them burning.
A cross of white fire three hexes out along every axis.
A spring of light wells up under the whole team and heals it.
Blesses the team: more Special Attack and Special Defense for two turns.
A bolt of pure light.
A pillar of light on one foe at up to four hexes: the Kirin's one real nuke.
Wraps the team in cleansing light. There is no cleanse mechanic: it is a shield and a Special Defense boost.
A ring of light heals and steadies every ally within two hexes.
Spits a venom that keeps working (poison, stacks three times).
Finds the most wounded enemy in reach and finishes it: up to +60% damage against a nearly dead target.
A glance that may turn the target to stone for a turn.
Four shadow bites in the blink of an eye: four crit rolls to find a weak point.
Narrows its eyes on the kill: +20 crit chance and more Special Attack for three turns.
A cross of poison fog three hexes out that lingers and weakens.

AvatarActives.Description: The avatar's war cry: +10% Attack and Special Attack for the whole team for three turns.
A gentle light that heals every beast a little.
Throws a shield over every beast, worth part of the avatar's Defense.
Curses every enemy: -10% Defense and Special Defense for three turns.
Sharpens the team's eye: +8 crit chance for three turns.
Thickens the air around the enemy: -12% Speed for three turns.

AvatarPassives.Description: Aura: every beast has +5 crit chance for the whole battle.
Aura: every beast has +5% Defense and Special Defense for the whole battle.
At the start of battle every beast gets a two-turn shield worth part of the avatar's Defense.
At the start of battle the team is quickened: +10% Speed for two turns.
At the start of battle every enemy is cursed: -10% Defense and Special Defense for three turns.
When an enemy falls, half the time the team surges: +10% Attack and Special Attack for two turns (at most once per avatar turn).
When a beast falls, the survivors rally: +15% Attack and Special Attack for three turns (twice a battle).
When a beast lands a critical hit, the avatar sometimes calls down a follow-up strike on every enemy.
Half the time a beast starts its turn, it recovers a little HP.
When a beast drops below 40% HP it is wrapped in a two-turn emergency shield (at most every other avatar tick).

TeamBonds.Description: Vanguards cover the beasts behind them: when an enemy's single-target attack is aimed at an adjacent non-Vanguard ally, a Vanguard may step in, bracing behind a small shield, and take the blow instead.
Skirmishers hunt as a pack: each gains critical-hit chance, and when an ally lands a critical hit, a Skirmisher within reach piles onto the same target.
Ranged beasts cover each other's angles: when an enemy's single-target attack hits a Ranged beast, another Ranged beast within range of the attacker may return fire.
Wind feeds the flame: when a Fire or Air beast fielded with the other lands a hit, the target may catch fire and burn for two turns.
Thunder over the deep: when a Lightning or Water beast fielded with the other lands a critical hit, the target may be stunned for a turn.
Stone and iron, layered: when an ally drops below half health, the healthiest Earth or Metal beast draws every enemy near it onto itself for two turns (once per ally per battle).
Evergreens under rime: when an ally drops below a third of its health, an Ice or Nature beast wraps it in a frost shield and mends it (once per ally per battle).
Light and Dark in balance: when an ally starts its turn stunned or burning, a Light or Dark beast clears it so the ally can act (twice per beast per battle).
A team fielding all three stances fights on when one falls: each time an ally is defeated, the rest hit harder, physical and special alike, for three turns (twice per battle).
